description: Shut down the Google OAuth callback uvicorn server and release its TCP port. Safe to call whether or not the server is running. Returns a stopped confirmation.
embedding_description: Tear down the Google Workspace OAuth redirect listener started by start_interface. Stops the background uvicorn event loop and frees the callback port. Call after the connect_account browser flow completes and tokens are vaulted, or to reclaim the port. Idempotent — returns stopped:true even if nothing was running.

result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the callback server was shut down and its port released.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Stop the Google OAuth callback uvicorn server.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Any error indicates the server thread could not be stopped cleanly.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Retry stop_interface; if the port stays bound, a platform restart releases it.
